Transaction verification tile with fragment filtering, parsing, dedup, and publish logic.

# Purpose
`fd_verify_tile.c` implements the `verify` tile in the transaction processing pipeline. It sets up the tile scratch space, security policy, file descriptor access, and runtime context, then connects the tile to the generic stem loop in `fd_stem.c`. The tile receives fragments from several input links, classifies each input as `QUIC`, `BUNDLE`, `GOSSIP`, or `SEND`, and uses that type to decide how to route and process each fragment. It also sets round-robin rules so multiple verify tiles can share work without mixing bundle streams.

The main work happens in [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) and [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>). [`during_frag`](<#during_frag>) copies incoming data into the output buffer and performs range checks, while [`after_frag`](<#after_frag>) parses the transaction, applies bundle failure handling, runs transaction verification and dedup checks, and publishes valid transactions with `fd_stem_publish`. The file also updates verification metrics, handles gossip vote updates by converting them into transaction messages, and defines the tile entry point `fd_tile_verify` for use by the runtime.
